title: asphodelus albus subsp. sphaerocarpus
intro: Asphodelus albus subsp. sphaerocarpus, commonly known as white asphodel, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the asphodel family. It is a perennial plant that is native to the Mediterranean region and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Asphodelus albus subsp. sphaerocarpus include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce swelling and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, and other compounds like flavonoids and saponins that contribute to its medicinal properties.
